blocking_findings: Legacy 10-working-day Pilot conflicts with current 30-Day Revenue Command Pilot.
Unsupported outcome metrics/claims including +40%, -60%, 3x, 30%+, 2x and 10x without customer proof.

agent_rule: Any agent selecting a Canva asset must consult this audit or a newer replacement. BLOCKED assets cannot be sent, published, exported as customer collateral or used as a factual source.
